justify_why_units_are_missing.justification: x-axes show flow cytometry measurements such as FSC-A, FSC-H, SSC-A and fluorescence marker intensities (e.g., CD19, IgD) which are continuous signals; no units are given (should specify channel/arbitrary fluorescence units or similar).

y-axes show flow cytometry measurements such as FSC-H, SSC-A or marker fluorescence (e.g., Fas, IgM) which are continuous signals; no units are given (should specify channel/arbitrary fluorescence units or similar).
x-axes display fluorescence or scatter intensities (e.g., CD19, IgD, NP or FSC-A) as continuous measurements but no units are indicated (should state arbitrary units / channel numbers).
y-axes display fluorescence or scatter intensities (e.g., CD98, FSC-A) as continuous measurements but no units are indicated (should state arbitrary units / channel numbers).
x-axes represent continuous fluorescence intensities (e.g., IgD, NP, CD138) from flow cytometry; units (arbitrary fluorescence units or channel numbers) are not specified.
y-axes represent continuous fluorescence intensities (e.g., IgM, Fas, CD38) from flow cytometry; units (arbitrary fluorescence units or channel numbers) are not specified.
x-axes plot marker fluorescence intensities (e.g., CD44, PD-L2) on a continuous scale; no units are provided (should indicate arbitrary fluorescence units or channel scale).
y-axes plot marker fluorescence intensities (e.g., CD62L, CD80) on a continuous scale; no units are provided (should indicate arbitrary fluorescence units or channel scale).
x-axes show continuous fluorescence intensity for markers (e.g., CD44) used for gating; units (arbitrary fluorescence units or instrument channel units) are not specified.
y-axes show continuous fluorescence intensity for markers (e.g., CD62L, CD80, PD-L2) used for gating; units (arbitrary fluorescence units or instrument channel units) are not specified.
